sections.title: Introduction to Applied Quantitative Methods for Education Research: Pre-K to 20
sections.description: An introduction to the interpretation and use of data about education policy issues through the use of computer-assisted methods of statistical analysis. Emphasis is on the implications for educational policy and research design.
